label: HEC-07 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a single-gene HEC-07 Hma-embedded candidate locus encoding a RelE domain-containing protein and reducing bacteriophage plaquing.
observations: RelE-domain Hma-embedded-candidate branch under phage defense system; distinct from broader Hma systems, Hma-embedded candidates in general, inactive HEC-01 and HEC-09 candidates, sibling HEC-02 through HEC-06 and HEC-08 systems, individual HEC-07 proteins, RelE-family toxin domains, the DefenseFinder HEC-07 profile row, the absent pinned DefenseFinder rule row, direct phage triggers or effector outputs, exact natural hosts or sensitive phages, and other phage-defense systems.
